# `curve.bezier`: Bezier curve

Creates a smooth cubic Bezier curve through points, with automatic or explicit handles.

- Category: curve
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(points)
- Flags: undoable, creates_objects
- Also known as: bezier, curve, spline, smooth curve, nurbs curve

Without `handles` the curve passes smoothly through every point (tangents bisect the neighbouring chords, handles a third of the chord long, so uneven spacing does not overshoot). Give `handles` for exact control: one `[in, out]` pair per point; a handle on the straight line to its neighbour makes that span straight.

Generators sample each curved span with their `resolution` (12 by default); straight spans stay one segment.

**Use for** vase and bottle profiles, handles, arches, cable and hose paths.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `closed` | `boolean` | `false` | Joins the last point back to the first. |
| `handles` | `[[Length, Length, Length], [Length, Length, Length]][] \| null` | - | One `[in, out]` handle pair per point (absolute positions); smooth automatic handles when omitted. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | - | Object name; a free name such as `bezier_1` is picked when omitted. |
| `parent` | `string \| null` | - | Parent object (name, path or id); top level when omitted. |
| `points` | `[Length, Length, Length][]` | required | Points the curve passes through, in object space. |
| `position` | `[Length, Length, Length]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Origin position in the parent's space. |

## Examples

```json
{"name":"arch","points":[[-0.5,0,0],[0,0.5,0],[0.5,0,0]]}
```

Result: `created arch (o:4) curve: 1 open bezier spline, 3 points, 1.4643 m long, 1 x 0.5 x 0 m`
